properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Azure Maps: Managed Identity Preferred Over Shared Key
properties.description: Audits Azure Maps accounts that do not have a managed identity configured. FedRAMP High requires identification and authentication (IA-2). Managed Identity with Entra ID RBAC is preferred over shared key authentication to enable centralized identity governance, conditional access policies, and audit logging of caller identity.

metadata.description: Audit: Report Azure Maps accounts without managed identity. Deny: Block deployment. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
